title: Automated Legal Document Summarization Pipeline
business: A boutique law firm managing thousands of discovery documents that require rapid, consistent summarization for litigation support.
problem: The firm faces high latency and inconsistent formatting when using generic, non-specialized model endpoints to process sensitive legal discovery files, leading to bottlenecks in case preparation.
solution: By utilizing Together AI's fine-tuning capabilities, the firm can adapt an open-source model to recognize specific legal terminology and document structures. This is paired with dedicated model inference to ensure consistent, low-latency access to the specialized model, bypassing the variability of shared serverless environments.
steps: Curate a high-quality dataset of annotated legal summaries for model fine-tuning.
Upload the dataset to the Together AI platform to initiate the fine-tuning process on a base open-source model.
Deploy the resulting fine-tuned model weights to a dedicated inference instance for consistent performance.
Integrate the dedicated endpoint into the firm's document management system via API calls.
outcome: The firm achieves highly accurate, domain-specific summaries that maintain a consistent tone and structure, significantly accelerating the attorney review process.
limitation: Dedicated inference instances require continuous resource allocation; the firm must monitor utilization rates to ensure the cost-to-performance ratio remains favorable compared to serverless alternatives.
